notes.title: Upcoming Vehicle Control Overhaul
notes.content:
Patch Note: Upcoming Vehicle Control Overhaul

We wanted to announce that there will be a complete overhaul of the vehicle controls in Machine of the Wasteland, which will also be implemented in the demo in a future update.

Vehicle Control Overhaul: We are introducing a complete overhaul of the vehicle control system. Expect improved steering responsiveness, smoother acceleration, and a more intuitive control layout that enhances the overall combat experience.
Demo Update: These improved controls won’t just be part of the final game—they will also be implemented in the demo version soon, allowing you to experience the changes firsthand.

This update is part of our ongoing commitment to refining the game based on player input. Stay tuned for more updates as we continue to polish and perfect Machine of the Wasteland.
